mascot: Family Friend Rina — a warm didi (big sister) with a photo album under her arm and a bag of mangoes to share

slides.title: My Family, My World 🏡
slides.text: A FAMILY is a group of people who love and care for each other. Amma, Appa, brothers, sisters, grandparents — family is where we all belong!
slides.spoken: A family is the group of people who love and care for us.

slides.title: Families Help Each Other 🤝
slides.text: In a family, everyone helps! Appa may go to work, Amma may cook, grandpa tells stories, and YOU can help too — by keeping your toys away and watering the plants!
slides.spoken: Everyone in a family helps in their own way.

slides.title: Big Families and Small Families 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
slides.text: A SMALL family has parents and children. A JOINT family has grandparents, uncles, aunts and cousins too! Big or small, every family is special.
slides.spoken: Families can be small or joint — both are full of love.

slides.title: Our Family Tree 🌳
slides.text: A family tree shows how we are connected! Grandparents are like the roots, Amma and Appa are the strong branches, and YOU are the newest leaf. Draw yours at home and label everyone!
slides.spoken: Grandparents are at the top of the family tree; you are the newest leaf!

slides.title: Caring for Our Family ❤️
slides.text: Families grow strong with CARE! Speak kind words, share your things, help grandparents walk, and give a big hug. Caring makes family love grow!
slides.spoken: Kind words and helping hands keep a family happy.

challenges.question: Your mother's mother is your ______.
challenges.hint: Your mother's mother — the mother of your mother!
challenges.misconception: Your mother's mother is your grandmother.

challenges.question: Your father's father is your ______.
challenges.hint: Your father's father — think of the oldest man in family photos!
challenges.misconception: Your father's father is your grandfather.

challenges.question: Who all live together in a JOINT family?
challenges.hint: Joint means joined together — many family members!
challenges.misconception: A joint family has grandparents, parents, uncles, aunts and children together.

challenges.question: How can YOU help at home?
challenges.hint: What small thing do YOU do that helps the family?
challenges.misconception: Keeping our own toys away is a real help at home!

challenges.question: Sort each person: family or not family?
challenges.hint: Family members live with us and love us like our own.
challenges.misconception: Grandmother and brother are family. Shopkeepers and postmen are helpers, not family.

challenges.question: When grandparents feel tired, what should we do?
challenges.hint: Think of the kindest thing to do!
challenges.misconception: Helping tired grandparents and bringing them water shows we care.

challenges.question: What does a family give us?
challenges.hint: More than toys — what does family really give?
challenges.misconception: A family gives us love, care and safety.

challenges.question: Your mother's sister is your ______.
challenges.hint: Your mother's sister — a special elder in the family!
challenges.misconception: Your mother's sister is your aunt.

beats.mascotDialogue: Family love makes us strong. You learned it all!
